newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Quake rocks Albania, but no injuries reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake rocks Albania, but no injuries reported.

text.p: An earthquake shook southern Albania on Wednesday, but there were no immediate reports of injuries or damage to buildings, the country's Seismological Institute said.
It said the quake measured 4.7 on the Richter scale, which could be powerful enough to cause serious structural damage in a heavily-populated area.
The quake's epicentre was reported to be near the town of Leskovik, about 170 km (105 miles) southeast of the capital Tirana on the Albanian-Greek border.
